Mobile Concreting Solutions is an industry leader in the manufacture and supply of construction materials in North-west Australia. Due to continued growth an exciting opportunity exists for an experienced and motivated Boilermakers and Fitters to join our dynamic team across regional WA and  in Pilbara - Karratha, Port Hedland, Tom Price Quarry and Onslow Quarry.

The successful Boilermaker candidates will need to have a minimum of 3 years’ experience in a similar role, and hold a relevant trade qualification, along with –

* Experience repairing quarry fixed and mobile plant
* Be proficient in various welding application including – Arc, Mig, Wire feed etc
* Be proficient in all forms of oxy acetylene cutting and braising
* Good understanding of different steel properties/functions
* Be prepared to travel predominantly within the Pilbara region to service our quarry and concrete operations
* Have a strong understanding and commitment to OH&S
* Ability to work independently
* An excellent mechanical aptitude
* Sound problem solving and decision-making skills

The successful Fitter candidates will need to have a minimum of 5 years experience working on Elevated work platforms, AWP, Boom lift, Scissor Lift, Forklift, telehandler, CAT, Komatsu, Volvo, earth moving vehicles etc. Duties and responsibilities are as follows:

* Detecting and diagnosing mechanical and electrical faults in engines and parts
* Dismantling and removing engine assemblies, transmissions, steering mechanisms and other components, and checking parts
* Performs preventive maintenance, troubleshooting and repairs on reverse osmosis units, pumps, valves, piping systems, water monitoring equipment and all auxiliary equipment as required
* Complies with applicable Safety, Environment, Health, and Waste Management policies and procedures
* Repairing and replacing worn and defective parts, reassembling mechanical components, and referring to service manuals as needed
* Monitors and performs preventive maintenance on waste heat recovery system and components

* Performing schedule maintenance services, such as oil changes, lubrications and engine tune-ups, to achieve smoother running of vehicles and ensure compliance with pollutions regulations
* Reassembling engines and parts after being repaired
* Testing and adjusting mechanical parts after being repaired for proper performance
* Diagnosing and testing parts with assistance of computer

Salary range: $75,000 - $95,000 per year (commensurate to skills and experience)

Required for an immediate start.

Weekly Payroll! Super paid on all hours!

MCS is an independent, Pilbara owned and operated business who pride themselves on delivering a quality product with exceptional service, whilst offering a safe, rewarding and enjoyable work environment.

Omega Auto & Smash Repair, located in Coopers Plains, QLD, is a trusted automotive service provider recognised for accurately diagnosing and resolving complex vehicle issues. Our experienced technicians utilise advanced testing and diagnostic techniques to identify faults, deliver precise repairs, and implement preventive measures to enhance long-term vehicle performance. We pride ourselves on offering exceptional service at competitive rates, giving customers confidence in the safety and reliability of their vehicles.

Position: Motor Mechanic

Location: Coopers Plains, QLD

Key Responsibilities
•	Perform thorough inspections to identify faults in engines and major vehicle systems, enabling accurate and timely repairs.
•	Dismantle, examine, and repair engines, transmissions, steering systems, and other key mechanical components, assessing wear and damage.
•	Install new or refurbished parts and reassemble mechanical systems using appropriate service manuals and specifications.
•	Conduct routine servicing to optimise vehicle efficiency and ensure compliance with environmental and industry standards.
•	Test repaired engines and systems using advanced diagnostic tools to verify proper functionality.
•	Assess vehicles for roadworthiness and identify repairs required to meet safety and compliance regulations.
•	Maintain and monitor stock levels of parts, tools, and consumables required for workshop operations.
•	Collaborate with team members to troubleshoot and resolve complex mechanical issues.
•	Accurately record all repair and maintenance activities for customer reference and warranty support.
•	Provide customers with clear guidance on maintenance requirements, repair options, and overall vehicle condition.

Work Hours: Full-time, 38 hours per week.

Requirements
•	Minimum 3 years of experience as a Motor Mechanic.
•	AQF Certificate III or IV in Automotive Mechanical Technology or a related discipline.

Salary: $75,000–$85,000 per annum plus superannuation.

Personal Attributes
•	Strong attention to detail with a commitment to delivering high-quality workmanship.
•	Excellent diagnostic, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work well under pressure.
•	Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with a collaborative approach.
•	Proactive attitude towards keeping up to date with industry developments and emerging technologies.

We are seeking motivated professionals who take pride in their work, value precision, and are committed to maintaining our high standards of service. Sopho Pty Ltd as trustee for the Sopho Unit Trust trading as Kangaroo Valley Golf & Country Retreat, operates a distinctive accommodation and hospitality destination in the heart of Kangaroo Valley, NSW, within the Southern Highlands and South Coast region and an easy two-hour drive from both Sydney and Canberra. The Retreat is centred on a historic 1901 Woolshed — relocated from Uri Park in outback NSW and lovingly restored in 1983 — which today houses The Woolshed Restaurant and provides a characterful setting for guests and private functions alike. The property is complemented by an 18-hole championship golf course designed by Jack Newton, and by Osteria La Vallata, an Italian-inspired fine-dining restaurant led by Chef Marco Salvestrin.

Welcoming overnight guests, golf and leisure visitors, function and event parties, and regional tourists, Kangaroo Valley Golf & Country Retreat delivers a premium accommodation and hospitality experience across its accommodation, dining, and recreation offerings. As a destination property in a popular regional tourism location, the Retreat depends on attentive, individualised guest care and consistent day-to-day operational oversight to maintain its standing and the high standard of guest experience for which it is known.

As part of its continued growth, Sopho Pty Ltd is seeking to appoint a skilled and experienced Accommodation and Hospitality Manager in a permanent full-time position. The role is responsible for the overall administration and day-to-day operation of Kangaroo Valley Golf & Country Retreat, with a primary focus on accommodation services and the personalised guest experience across the property. The role offers a salary range of AUD $75,000 to AUD $85,000 per annum plus superannuation, commensurate with the successful candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.

Job tasks and responsibilities
1.  Direct and oversee major accommodation - related operations such as reservations, reception, room service, and housekeeping activities across the property's 30 self-contained one-, two-, and three-bedroom cabins and villas, ensuring that turnaround, presentation, and guest check-in/check-out standards are consistently met.
2.  Plan and coordinate special functions, conferences and private events held in the Conference & Events Centre, liaising with clients on room setup, AV/presentation equipment and catering requirements.
3.  Coordinate closely with the Executive Chef to align front-of-house service delivery with kitchen output, executing and leading front-of-house service across Osteria La Vallata restaurant, in-room dining and event catering to deliver a seamless overall guest hospitality experience.
4.  Direct the Greenkeeper Superintendent and golf course maintenance team to ensure the 18-hole championship course and surrounding grounds are presented and maintained to the standard expected of guests and members.
5.  Supervise security arrangements and, through the Maintenance Manager, the upkeep of buildings, gardens, pools, tennis courts and other recreational facilities used by guests.
6.  Oversee the selection, training, rostering and supervision of accommodation, guest services, maintenance, golf course and other staff, and ensure compliance with occupational health and safety regulations across the site.
7.  Observe liquor licensing, food safety, health and other regulatory requirements relevant to the accommodation, restaurant, golf and function operations.
8.  Assess and review guest and customer satisfaction through feedback channels and online review platforms, and implement service improvements accordingly.
9.  Oversee purchasing and accounting activities related to accommodation, hospitality and course-maintenance operations, including supplier arrangements for housekeeping, maintenance, kitchen and guest amenities.
10.  Provide guests with local tourism information and coordinate golf, dining and activity bookings as part of the retreat experience, arranging tours or transport where required.
11.  Handle guest complaints and service escalations, negotiating with suppliers and other stakeholders to resolve issues, and conduct ongoing quality checks across accommodation, dining and event operations, initiating corrective action where standards are not met.
12.  Lead public relations and marketing initiatives to promote the Retreat and grow accommodation patronage
13.  Report on operational performance, staffing and guest service outcomes to the Operations Manager and General Manager, and contribute to forward operational planning, performance forecasting and risk management to support the retreat's ongoing service standards and growth.

How to join the team
To join our dedicated team for a rewarding career, please submit an online application. Only successful applicants will be contacted. Candidates must hold Australian or NZ Citizenship or have the capacity to permanently work in Australia. Employment of a temporary visa holder may only occur if no suitable permanent resident or citizen of Australia has been identified for this position following suitable labour market testing.

Motor Mechanic-Full-time 

Motor Mechanic-Full-time position vacant at automotive workshop Gladstone Tyres & Auto Pty Ltd trading as Tyrepower Gladstone, ABN:  88 646 303 648, at 93 Hanson Road, Gladstone, Qld-4680. Minimum 38 hours a week. 

Job Description:  

Performing scheduled maintenance services, such as oil changes, lubrications and engine tune-ups, to achieve smoother running of vehicles. 

Repair and replacing worn and defective parts and reassembling mechanical components and referring to service manuals as needed. 

Detecting and diagnosing faults in engines and parts with the assistance of computers. 

Dismantling and removing engine assemblies, transmissions, steering mechanisms and other components, and checking parts. 

check and repair suspensions, brakes and wheel alignments of automotive vehicles. 

Reassembling engines and parts following repair. 

Manage stock reordering and inventory as directed, putting the stock (for example brakes, sparkplugs, oil filters) at the proper places. 

Maintain and manage tools, equipment, and machinery in good condition. 

Deliver outstanding customer service at all times, ensuring a professional and polite manner when communicating with customers. 

Full adherence to regulations, relating to pollution and health and safety at all times. 

 

Maintaining a clean and safe working environment through ensuring the correct operation of all tools and specialised equipment. 

 

Coordinating with other mechanics where teamwork was needed. 

 

Applicant must have: 

Completed at least Cert-III in automotive and at least 3 years of full-time work experience as a motor mechanic. Experience in servicing Hybrid cars would be preferred. Must know how to work on Asian, Intercontinental and European car models. 

Must hold a current driver's license and Licensed Vehicle Tester 

A desire to achieve results. 

 

Annual Salary (depending on experience/skills) between $79,000 - $82,000 plus superannuation.  

Only successful candidates will be contacted.
